plugins.name: ios-test-harness
plugins.description: Build and RUN an iOS app in GitHub Actions — compile for the simulator, launch it, screenshot/record every screen, and report to Telegram, a GitHub issue, or a secret gist. Use when asked to test an iOS app in CI, get screenshots or video of an iOS app, diagnose which screens crash, compile a private iOS/KMP project on free macOS runners, or when no Mac is available. Repo: oranblock/ios-test-harness.
